target_buyer.why_top_candidate: Helps residents access assistance programs. Served 11,763 residents last year, provided 100,290 meals to seniors/disabled, weatherized 99 households. Eligibility screening tools would help clients quickly identify which programs to apply for.

actual_brand_research.mission: Community Action helps people and changes lives. Ashtabula County Community Action will help people achieve self-sufficiency and rise above issues of poverty.
actual_brand_research.promise: Community Action changes people's lives, embodies the spirit of hope, improves communities, and makes America a better place to live.

brandkit_for_mvp.proposed_tagline: Quick Check. Clear Answers. Right Benefits.
brandkit_for_mvp.positioning: The lightweight eligibility screener for Ashtabula County Community Action Agency — helping residents quickly understand which assistance programs they may qualify for.

visual_direction.hero_image_concept: Diverse community members accessing services with hopeful expressions
visual_direction.color_scheme: Warm greens conveying growth, hope, and community support

implementation_recommendations.brand_alignment: Align with ACCAA's mission of helping people achieve self-sufficiency
differentiators_based_on_research: Lightweight and fast (vs. full state portal)
